name: Memory Starved
summary: Advantage on Investigation checks, and Advantage on saves against Charmed and against having your memories read or altered.

benefits.name: Desperate Detail
benefits.text: You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks.

benefits.name: Iron Mind
benefits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition and to avoid having your memories read or altered.
benefits.text: You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed condition, and on saving throws made to avoid having your memories read or altered.
